title: 'Kenopsia'
content: TheDictionary of Obscure Sorrowsis a website and book created by John Koenig which defines words that don't exist in English, but it feels like theyshouldexist.Painting byAntonio López García(b. 1936)For example, he definesKenopsiaas "the eerie, forlorn atmosphere of a place that’s usually bustling with people but is now abandoned and quiet—a school hallway in the evening, an unlit office on a weekend, vacant fairgrounds—an emotional afterimage that makes it seem not just empty but hyper-empty, with a total population in the negative, who are so conspicuously absent they glow like neon signs."--Wikipedia:Dictionary of Obscure SorrowsWebsite:Dictionary of Obscure SorrowsBooks:Antonio López GarcíaThe Dictionary of Obscure Sorrows
